notes: The author compares a cyclic permutation with products of three sigma automorphisms. He cancels a commutator-style equation, inserts the equal products in the permutation group, and then writes three explicit calculations on l_0, l_1 and l_infty. He states that sigma_0 sigma_1 differs from rho by conjugation with l_1 inverse, with two cyclic analogues. These are descriptions of his text, not a verification by this reader.

The author says the S_3 representation exists only in the exterior group “à lacets”. The wording is retained. He writes “ne peut espérer réaliser” the exterior operation by a genuine one, with the express qualification “du moins [pas sur / pour / par sur] le groupe discret”, with the compressed qualification now explicitly uncertain, and appeals to the absence of a fixed point on the punctured projective line. He contrasts this with the cyclic subgroup and its one, “et bar-m deux!”, fixed point(s). The inserted algebraic expression naming that point remains uncertain.

The final paragraph begins “Signalons aussi qu’on écrira ...” in the proposed reading, against C’s “a inclus”. It mentions the Teichmüller group, an interlinear Gamma_0,3 acting on a capital-Pi group with subscript0,3, and “conjugaison complexe”. The sentence continues beyond this page; no continuation was consulted.

No date is visible. The lower-left handwritten page number is 5. No numbered display is visible. The small right-hand isolated 2/z/t/tau-like mark is provisionally transcribed but needs adjudication as a possible stray pen mark. The margin number’s hand is not independently attributed.

All three required views were made once, and every main and inserted line was read. Eighteen distinct first-reading crops were created and viewed once each. The bar-m forms were compared locally on the supplied page. No other page, other reader output, OCR, recognition software, external research, was used by the first reader. The main reader subsequently performed the local word computation described below. No clear authorial mathematical slip was asserted or silently corrected.

Certainty-only additions are recorded in doubts: the possible contraction provient/pvt, the short live a, and initially the case of the two inserted pi forms (the final one is resolved as capital Pi in the blind audit). The four ornate S alphabet choices and the two cancelled stretches remain open. C’s uncertainty on struck l_1 remains after main-reader adjudication: its small index is entangled with the strike. The new sign alternative ± barred-j is retained explicitly rather than forced to the expected fixed-point notation.

The main reader performed a conditional free-word check of the three displayed inner-conjugation identities, taking the preferred cyclic readings of the still-uncertain scan005 indices as assumptions. With a=l₀, b=l₁ and c=l∞=(ab)⁻¹, the code assumes rho(a)=b and rho(b)=c; sigma-infinity(a)=b and sigma-infinity(b)=a; sigma0(a)=b⁻¹c⁻¹ and sigma0(b)=c; and sigma1(a)=c and sigma1(b)=c⁻¹a⁻¹. Under these assumed maps, free reduction gives σ₀σ₁=int(b⁻¹)ρ, σ₁σ∞=int(c⁻¹)ρ, and σ∞σ₀=int(a⁻¹)ρ on both free generators. The calculation and reduced-word output are saved in scripts/check_006_words.py and reader_reports/145_scan006_word_check.json. This verifies the identities for the stated interpretation; it does not determine the uncertain scan005 indices, prove the exterior-action realization claim, or normalize the doubtful fixed-point expression.

The independent image-only reading prompted four changed boxes: local parenthesis/cancelled-factor uncertainty in the calculation, a possible pas sur previously compressed to pour, capital Pi in the Teichmüller insertion, and tau among the isolated-mark alternatives. This does not change the conditional inner-conjugation calculation under the assumed preferred cyclic generator maps and does not resolve the remaining scan005 indices; the only equation change is explicit uncertainty about ink already present or obscured. The complete first, second and final readings are retained in the audit table.
